status: proposed local SEO workflow; no scheduling, publication or deployment authorized by this document

baseline.staticBody: Implemented locally; uncommitted and not confirmed live
baseline.liveCheck: Web retrieval of robots.txt and sb-001 failed; this does not establish an outage or indexing failure.
baseline.gsc: Not accessed; property, index coverage and performance baseline unverified.
baseline.conversion: ContactForm opens a mailto draft. Draft opening is not a confirmed sent/received inquiry. No analytics integration found in reviewed source.

adopt: Commercial hub, subtype, buyer guide and inquiry links
Answer-first content with useful original tables/checklists/drawings
Separate implemented, tested, deployed, live-verified and indexed states
doNotTransfer: Fixed article counts without evidence and editorial capacity
Historical Rucheng GSC metrics or rankings

phases.name: Baseline and evidence
tasks: Verify live HTTP status, canonical host, route HTML, unknown-route 404, robots, sitemap and retired-route redirects.
Obtain GSC property and finalized query/page/country/device cohorts; compare equal complete 7-day and 28-day periods; record extraction time and data-through date.
Review About/Home/Equipment claims: ±0.001 mm capability, 15 years, decades, certifications, customer industries and equipment ownership. Claims are unverified, not established false.
Record analytics and real inquiry measurement availability separately.
phases.doneWhen: Dated technical baseline, evidence queue and explicit data gaps exist.

phases.name: Commercial pages and crawl paths
tasks: Complete desktop/mobile preview of current static-body implementation, gallery, zoom, language restoration and client navigation.
Expand audit beyond product links to all internal URLs, anchors, sitemap/noindex mismatches and schema page-purpose checks.
Use existing family URLs as hubs; preserve ten-family taxonomy and existing IDs. No new category pages solely for keywords.
Review six homepage category cards linking to /products?category=...; consider direct links to existing family hubs while keeping a full-catalog entry.
Keep family pages focused on choosing among subtypes and children focused on geometry, process and mounting.
Review Product schema on family overview pages; separate Schema.org validity from Google rich-result eligibility. No invented prices/ratings.
phases.doneWhen: Priority buyer paths work in actual browser and local audit passes; publication remains a separate authorized step.

phases.name: Pilot topic clusters
phases.priorityBasis: Provisional content readiness, not search volume or business profitability; reorder using GSC, actual inquiries and confirmed supply priorities.

clusters.firstAsset: Shear blade replacement drawing checklist: overall size, holes, edge and upper/lower position
clusters.evidence: Confirmed drawings and machine arrangement; no universal clearance settings.

clusters.firstAsset: Slitting knife inquiry checklist by cutting method, material, holder and matched-knife arrangement
clusters.evidence: Actual cutting method and application evidence; distinguish rs-001 rolling shear family.

clusters.firstAsset: Punch/die/clamp selection checklist: tang, working height, profile, clearance and verified load ratings
clusters.evidence: Nearblade tooling drawings; avoid duplicating Rucheng machine-buying intent.

firstMonthCandidateArticles: Shear blade replacement dimensions and mounting checklist
Guillotine versus swing-beam replacement blade fit
Paper/film versus foil slitting inquiry requirements
Slitting knife drawing and holder-interface checklist
Press brake punch and die interface identification
Straight versus gooseneck punches: clearance and rating checks
Blade replacement records and drawing revision checklist
phases.cadence: Start with 2 evidence-backed articles and 2-3 distinct existing-page improvements per week; review capacity and outcomes after four weeks. No filler quota.

phases.name: Conversion and authority
tasks: Track product/guide/quote transitions and email/WhatsApp clicks if analytics is configured; keep received qualified inquiries separate.
Use product-specific inquiry subjects and relevant drawing/quantity/material inputs; verify current form behavior before adding new collection services.
Prepare a useful blade drawing checklist or inspection-record asset.
Verify company identity and real factory/inspection media; retain internal image provenance.
Build relevant legitimate directory/profile/link prospects and outreach drafts. Sending messages or posting requires separate authorization.

phases.name: Measurement and expansion
tasks: After authorized deployment verify ordinary live URLs, current assets, static body and release identity.
Record sitemap submission and warranted GSC URL inspection separately from confirmed indexation.
Review crawl/technical state at 7 days and query cohorts and buyer paths at 14/28 days, longer for low volume.
Observe recently changed pages instead of repeatedly rewriting titles.
Choose additional language URLs only after market evidence and translation capacity; existing client dictionaries do not create independent localized indexable versions.

perTaskWorkflow: Read last report, current worktree and observation queue.
Select one documented problem using GSC or a clearly labeled source/content hypothesis.
Check intent and existing URL inventory; use current URL unless a separate purpose is established.
Collect primary technical evidence and inspect assets.
Implement content, relevant inbound/outbound links, translations and matching metadata/schema.
Run affected checks and full required build; visually inspect new pages/layout changes.
Record local result; commit/publish only under applicable authorization.
After authorized release, verify live output and record observation dates.
contentGate: Answer the specific buyer question early with conditions attached.
Include useful independent value: decision table, dimensioned drawing/checklist or documented example; no mandatory arbitrary word count.
Technical numbers require source, scope, units and conditions.
No invented customer cases, expert sign-off, manufacturer claims or copied competitor promises.
Related product and quote links must be relevant and crawlable.
Maintain all nine existing translation packs for changed visible strings.
GEO follows readable evidence-based SEO; no hidden AI instructions or ranking claims for llms.txt.
reportFields: Data source, property, period and filters
